# Folder

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Folder")`

A container for grouping instances. It has no behavior of its own. Each subdirectory of a script folder under `src/` becomes a `Folder` when the project loads.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.
